svg.title: The red heading — an open word and the RATIO candidate
svg.desc: The original red heading is ᛋᚻᛖᚩᚷᛗᛡᚠ • ᛋᚣᛖᛝᚳ. The left word has eight runes and remains unknown. The five runes of the right word minus the repeated key J, TH, TH, J, TH modulo 29 yield R, A, T, I, O. This is a candidate heading reading. Extending X(16,9) to AE(17,13) by the same vector (+1,+4) reaches R(18,17). The node J–R–TH becomes J–TH–TH by the center-only totient φ(4)=2, with phase 0.

g.aria-label: A clue in the red heading
